shell_commands:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(orchestrator): acceptance tests for onError with non-Error rejections

Define expected behavior: onError receives wrapped non-Error rejections with
the original as cause, while the caller still receives the original unchanged.
Three test cases verify string, plain object, and undefined rejections.

Existing tests for Error rejections remain unedited and must stay green to
validate Error rejections are not wrapped and reach onError as the same instance.
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -1

git commit --amend --no-edit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(orchestrator): acceptance tests for onError with non-Error rejections

Define expected behavior: onError receives wrapped non-Error rejections with
the original as cause, while the caller still receives the original unchanged.
Three test cases verify string, plain object, and undefined rejections.

Existing tests for Error rejections remain unedited and must stay green to
validate Error rejections are not wrapped and reach onError as the same instance.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -1
git push origin HEAD && git log --oneline -1
